text: The Boeing Company is a listed US company whose largest shareholders are investment firms: its 2026 proxy statement lists The Vanguard Group (9.0%), FMR (7.0%) and BlackRock (6.8%) as the holders of more than 5% of its stock.

source.name: The Boeing Company: 2026 Proxy Statement (DEF 14A), Principal Shareholders (SEC EDGAR)
source.quote: The Vanguard Group 100 Vanguard Boulevard Malvern, Pennsylvania 19355 70,989,325(1) 9.0% FMR LLC 245 Summer Street Boston, Massachusetts 02210 54,979,044(2) 7.0% BlackRock, Inc. 50 Hudson Yards New York, New York 10001 52,979,795(3) 6.8%

additionalSources.name: TheStreet (Dominic Diongson), via Yahoo Finance: Boeing stock ownership: Institutional and executive shareholders
additionalSources.quote: The company's four largest institutional shareholders owned between 53 million and 71 million shares apiece, and together, they accounted for about 23% of Boeing's ownership.
